messages.subject: Goodbyes, Hellos, and Summer D-RUG
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,

Tara Pozzi, long time member and CooRdinator, has finished her Ph.D. on effective environmental governance and will be moving on to greener pastures. However, she is not leaving us quite yet, so please congratulate her if you see her at D-RUG over the next few weeks.

Additionally, Jenny Cribbs of the Ecology Grad Group and active D-RUG member, is our newest cooRdinator! Yay! 

We are now in summer schedule D-RUG. That means we will be primarily remote (fully remote this Thursday 6/26). However, people have expressed interest in meeting up in person, both in Davis and Sacramento. If you would like to have input on these in person meetups (when and where they happen), please join us on the r-users-group slack channel on the UC Davis slack.

Zoom Link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

Welcome to summer!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
